findings.summary: Captured jutsu records differ from the 32b pool registry summary (record wins for implementation; pool doc needs a refresh)
Tempest Cleave (existing EVENT jutsu, AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN, friendlyFire ALL) hits Master of Arms himself at short range

Extermination Order is chosen at a decision where Final Stand has already reached 0 rounds: routers/combat.ts runs alignBattle (lowers rounds to 0, no pruning) then performAIaction, and has_effect sums raw power without isEffectActive — 'only while Final Stand is active' is not guaranteed by the authored rule 2
